# rustinion_dashboard (Resource)

Manages a Rustinion custom dashboard: an ordered list of widgets (metric_chart, kpi_tile, alert_rule_status, or log_search). See dashboards.rs in the main repo for exactly what each widget_type's config expects.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `group_id` (String)
- `name` (String)

### Optional

- `default_time_range_days` (Number) The dashboard-wide time range, in days: one of 1, 7, 14, 30 or 90. Applies only to widgets whose config sets "use_dashboard_time_range": true; every other widget keeps its own "days". Omit for no shared range.
- `widget` (Block List) One widget, in display order. Reordering this list and re-applying reorders the dashboard. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--widget))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

<a id="nestedblock--widget"></a>
### Nested Schema for `widget`

Required:

- `title` (String)
- `widget_type` (String) One of: metric_chart, kpi_tile, alert_rule_status, log_search.

Optional:

- `config` (String) The widget's config as a JSON string, shape depending on widget_type: metric_chart: {"metric_type": "...", "days": 7, "aggregation": "avg", "tag_key": "...", "tag_value": "..."} (aggregation/tag_key/tag_value all optional, tag_key+tag_value both-or-neither, only meaningful for a custom:<name> metric_type); kpi_tile: {"metric_type": "...", "window_minutes": 60, "aggregation": "avg", "tag_key": "...", "tag_value": "..."} (same optional fields as metric_chart); alert_rule_status: {} (no config); log_search: {"message_pattern": "...", "severity": "error"|"warning", "days": 7} (all fields optional).
- `width` (String) How much of a row this widget occupies: full (the default), half or third.
